title: Score Note Payload
description: Columnar note events from the 'notes' facet of the Distant Listening Corpus (all descriptor columns except the row identifiers and the two extent columns, each as a parallel array).

mc.description: Running count of encoded <Measure> tags which do not necessarily express a full measure (e.g. in case of an anacrusis).

mn.description: Measure number as printed in the score, computed from mc, dont_count and numbering_offset.

quarterbeats.description: Distance from the piece's beginning, leaving out alternative endings. The descriptor declares fraction strings; dimcat materializes Fractions, which BOPP stores as floats (quarter notes).

mc_onset.description: Distance of an event from the beginning of the <Measure> tag. The descriptor declares fraction strings; dimcat materializes Fractions, which BOPP stores as floats (quarter notes).

mn_onset.description: Distance from the beginning of the logical measure. The descriptor declares fraction strings; dimcat materializes Fractions, which BOPP stores as floats (quarter notes).

timesig.description: Time signature, given as string, e.g. "4/4".

staff.description: Number of the staff where an event occurs, 1 designating the top staff.

voice.description: Notational layer, a number between 1-4 where 1 is MuseScore's default layer.

duration.description: Duration as fraction of a whole note. The descriptor declares fraction strings; dimcat materializes Fractions, which BOPP stores as floats (whole notes).

gracenote.description: Name given to a type of grace note in the MuseScore encoding, e.g. "grace16".

nominal_duration.description: The duration corresponding to a note/rest value without applying any dots or n-tuplets, as fraction of a whole note. The descriptor declares fraction strings; dimcat materializes Fractions, which BOPP stores as floats (whole notes).

scalar.description: Decimal value reflecting all dots and n-tuplets modifying the duration of a note/rest. The descriptor declares fraction strings; dimcat materializes Fractions, which BOPP stores as floats.

tied.description: 1 if a note is tied to the following one, -1 if it is being tied to by the previous one, 0 if both.

tpc.description: Tonal pitch class, specified on the line of fifths such that 0 = C, 1 = G, -1 = F, etc.

midi.description: MIDI pitch, value between 0 and 127 where 60 = C4, 61 = C#4/Db4, etc.

octave.description: Octave number where 4 is the middle octave (' in Helmholtz notation).

tremolo.description: Tremolo marking from the MuseScore encoding.

volta.description: Number of an ending bracket, given as integer.

tuning.description: Detuning information from the MuseScore encoding.
